routeGeometry.routeDescription: From Ammarnäs village context, official text describes crossing Tjulån and following signs to Entré Kungsleden / Äjvesåjvvie. The state trail line begins at the ledstart/parking above the village and climbs through forest toward open mountain. The route passes old sallows and reserve information, crosses Ruovdatjjuhkka canyon/waterfall bridges, offers views over Ammarnäs and the Vindelälven-Tjulån delta, then continues across wetter/open terrain and small bridges toward Aigertstugan.

rulesAndSafety.summary: No Ammarnäs-Aigert route closure, reroute or bridge outage was found on 2026-04-30. The section is within Vindelfjällen/Natura context and should carry reserve rules, dog/reindeer sensitivity, spring condition, hut-season, fire/weather, hunting and fishing currentness caveats.

records.details: No Ammarnäs-Aigert closure, reroute or bridge outage found. A 2026-04-16 current notice says state ski/snowmobile route poles are being removed early because of snow conditions; users must assess conditions locally.

Section is within Vindelfjällen nature reserve/Natura 2000. Rules prohibit disturbing wildlife, disturbing reindeer herding, damaging natural features and motorized travel except on designated roads/tracks/routes/areas.
Marsivagge bird protection 15 May-1 Aug is a standing Vindelfjällen rule, but the rules lane found it not applicable to section 22.

Länsstyrelsen snowmobile notice published 2026-03-30, updated 2026-03-31 16:47, says reindeer are grazing in Björkfjället/Skebleskalet and affected snowmobile users should choose another route. Permanent snowmobile prohibition applies outside public snowmobile trails for others.

Dog extra-control period is 1 Mar-20 Aug. Reindeer are especially sensitive during calving/small-calf period Apr-Jun, especially May. Hikers should leash/control dogs and avoid walking directly toward grazing reindeer.

No yellow/orange/red SMHI warning was found intersecting this Västerbotten/Sorsele section. Forecast created 2026-04-30T01:17:02Z for Aigert grid had 0.3-6.0 C, max wind 8.9 m/s, max gust 18.7 m/s, no precipitation and no thunder probability for the next 24 hours.

STF Aigert 2026 opening dates: 27 Feb-3 May and 18 Jun-20 Sep. Aigert was open on 2026-04-30, but full hut service closes after 2026-05-03 until 2026-06-18. One room in the safety hut is open year-round as emergency space.

Small-game hunting on state land above the cultivation boundary runs 25 Aug-15 Sep for residents/close-ties priority and 16 Sep-15 Mar for all with permit. Season was not active on 2026-04-30; NatureIT hunting-area closures affect hunting, not hiking.

Fishing requires applicable permits and rules in state mountain waters. General stream fishing closure 15 Sep-15 Oct; quota-water application 1 Jan-30 Apr; household-fishing application 1 Feb-31 Mar. No effect on walking section 22.

conditionReports.summary: Good trail, uphill but not too steep through forest/quad-bike-track-like section, three waterfall bridges, cold drinking water, views over Ammarnäs delta and broadly level final approach to Aigert.
8 km / 3-4 h / +350 m; mostly good forest trail, gradual climb above treeline, boggy sections, steeper near hut, Aigert lakeside sauna, host and well-stocked shop.
Started 17:30 due heat, reached Aigert 20:15; forest plus bogland, three waterfall bridges, mosquitoes/gnats and two lakes at Aigert. Sauna closure was COVID-era and historical.
Recent reviews report good views/conditions in August 2025, muddy/icy/snowy conditions in October 2025 and perceived easy difficulty despite route labels.
Reverse Aigertstugan-Ammarnäs track, 4.93 mi, 2h26, moderate, with waterfall waypoint.
Tent set at Ruovdatjjávrátje opposite STF Aigertstugan. A second July 2014 Utsidan photo report says final night tented at Aigertstugan, sauna heating, 8 km to Ammarnäs.
Ammarnäs resupply then climb out across river/up valley side; Aigert used for tea/sock change. Thick fog/wind beyond Aigert toward Lill-Aigert made markers hard to see, mostly a section-23 caveat.

sourceContradictions.topic: Official 8 km distance versus 6.1-6.4 km line length
sourceContradictions.details: STF, Naturkartan and Vindelfjällen all report 8 km, but WFS/Naturkartan GPX ledstart-to-Aigert geometry measures about 6.1-6.4 km. OSM clips from naturum/village give about 7.46 km and full relation with Näsberget/Liftvägen connector gives about 8.69 km.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Keep official display distance 8 km, but store geometry length and endpoint-zone caveat. Do not force geometry to match 8 km by stitching unchosen connectors.

sourceContradictions.details: STF gives 2-3 hours; Naturkartan/Länsstyrelsen gives 3-4 hours.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Use STF 2-3 hours for STF-derived overview if needed, but preserve Naturkartan time in source notes.

sourceContradictions.topic: Ammarnäs start bridge and endpoint convention
sourceContradictions.details: STF says the stage starts in Ammarnäs village at the bridge over Vindelälven. Naturkartan says start from naturum, cross Tjulån, follow signs to Entré Kungsleden parking, or drive to the parking. Official line geometry starts at the ledstart/parking.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Model Ammarnäs as an endpoint zone and choose one explicit connector policy. Do not merge naturum, bus stop, ledstart, Näsberget and parking into one point.

sourceContradictions.details: STF stage short label is Aigert, while Naturkartan/Vindelfjällen and facility sources use Aigertstugan / STF Aigert Fjällstuga.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Use Aigert as section alias and Aigertstugan/STF Aigert Fjällstuga for endpoint/facility normalization.

sourceContradictions.details: OSM maps an emergency=phone node at Aigert, but STF/Naturkartan state there is no help phone and official Anordningar has no Aigert help-phone record.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Suppress emergency phone unless a future official source contradicts current STF/Naturkartan evidence.

sourceContradictions.details: TimeOfTiger reported the sauna closed during COVID in 2021, but current STF/Naturkartan and 2014 field photo evidence support sauna availability.
